review.scope: Listed mechanics checked against the official current entry or SRD 5.2.1. Tier and acquisition advice are Compendium editorial judgments, not official rules.

compendium.summary: An opaque damaging boundary for chokepoints and coordinated forced movement. Strong when positioning produces repeated damage, weaker when enemies can simply leave.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: Choose the damaging side before placing it. Appearance allows a Dexterity save; the spell's later entry/end-position damage follows different triggers and does not inherit that initial save.
Coordinate pushes with the first-entry-per-turn limit and the end-of-turn wording. Do not count every square crossed or combine overlapping triggers into invented extra ticks.
The wall needs a solid surface. Friendly routes, fire resistance and your concentration budget matter; higher slots add 1d8 damage per slot level.
